text: Networked communication makes complete bureaucratic transparency possible, because every member of an organization can connect immediately with every other member worldwide at speed and low cost.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205

isBasedOn.name: Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization

abstract: Networked communication from the internet allows each member of the organi- zation to immediately connect with every other member on the globe. Complete bu- reaucratic transparency is possible as global communication is speedy and affordable.
